This entire thing is based on the coreless slimes, where slimes don't have a big solid weakness that undermines their whole gimmick/physiology.

So, lets start with defense. Slimes are blobs of amorphous, semi intelligent liquid slime held together by magic energy. Since stabbing/chopping/hitting it will, at the very most, result in tiny pieces of it coming off on you, I think its safe to say they're immune to physical weapons, short of magic weapons imbued with magic.

Earth and wind type magics suffer the same problems as physical weapons, and while one could technically boil it with fire magic, getting it into a situation where it can't put the fire out, or absorb the pot long enough to boil is so impractical we'll rule that out as well. While water magic can freeze the slime, and from there one can break it, since there's no core required, this serves as a method of forced splitting and is not advised. Light and Dark magics work, light because it's a counter magic designed to damage the magic energy directly (which is why it works so much on undeads, as they have nothing supporting them other than magic), and dark magics such as life drain directly suck the health away, and even with these two magics, unless they are of a rather high intensity, they will be absorbed by the slime and used as a catalyst for evolution.

Now that we've established why they're hard to kill, lets explain why they can kill you. A slime has five basic abilities: Body Bash (an ability that flings them forward at high speeds to deal damage), Absorb (Can melt almost anything it touches, short of adamantine/mithril/etc. and absorbs it as sustenance), Split (splits the slime into two slimes, each with half the mass of the original), Combine (combines to bigger and better forms, 100 slimes=1 big slime, 5 big slimes=1 huge slime and two huge slimes is a king slime), and Evolve (turns into a different type of slime based on the sustenance it eats, I.e. a slime that eats metal will become a metal slime, or a slime that eats blood will be a blood slime. It gains bonuses but also weaknesses, such as metal slimes being susceptible to physical attacks and slower, but being able to eat all metals including mythril,etc. and dealing more damage w/ body bash). Because of these skills, it is virtually impossible to contain or escape from them. They will find you, and they will eat you. And there is nothing you can do about it.
Slimes should really be the most terrifying things in all of RPGs.
